profile.summary: Laxmi Cotspin Limited engages in the processing of textiles in India. The company provides cotton yarn, as well as ring spinning, open end, and TFO yarns; cotton bales; oilseeds; and oil mill products, such as gold and silver oil cake, wash oil, and oil sediment. It exports its products to Asian and European countries. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Jalna, India.
